entries.title: The Assassin Story
entries.body: Your public claim is Rogue Assassin. Your actual class is College of Valor Bard.

entries.title: Journeyman
entries.body: Learn what Journeyman means, determine why the records contradict one another, and protect your right to choose what you become.

entries.title: The Name Auri
entries.body: Your fantasy body is publicly known as Auri, the celebrated main performer of Sunwheel Circus. You remain Celis, and you do not remember Auri’s life.

entries.title: Daughter of Auren
entries.body: You know that you are a daughter of Auren. The light speaks to you with warmth, but much of that bond remains unexplained.

entries.title: What the Body Remembers
entries.body: Auri’s body remembers how the costume fastens, where the props belong, which entrance leads to the ring, how to breathe before a performance, and how to move when the music begins. Celis does not consciously remember learning any of it.

entries.title: Sunwheel Circus
entries.body: The crowd knows Auri. The performance waits beneath the painted sun.

entries.title: Auren’s Warning
entries.body: When the third bell rings, leave the painted sun. Take them with you. Protection is not the same as safety.

entries.title: Separation Record
entries.body: You were placed where the light could still reach you. The reason the others were taken remains withheld.
